diagram.documentation:
The full gUFO taxonomy of class inheritance, showing all classes (including unions and superclass intersections) with constraints.

 

The full type hierarchy of named gUFO classes plus the «Union» and «Superclass Intersection» classes and the stereotyped dependencies («Disjoint With» and «Complement Of»), created by the CCM importer.

The diagram is arranged to correspond as closely as possible to the Taxonomy diagram in the UFO Formalization Diagrams.vpp model. For the formal representation of majority elements on this diagram, see A First-Order Logic Formalization of the Unified Foundational Ontology [Porelo et al., 2021]. gUFO adds some elements compared to the UFO Formalization, but also lacks some elements defined in the UFO Formalization. Most of the elements are common to both however.

 

For a more detailed version of this diagram, see gUFO Metamodel - Classes full taxonomy per gUFO TTL incl. unions/intersections, constraints (Disjointness, Complement Of ), attributes
